annotations.title: Menu price and food cost % for a dish (paid, $0.01)

description:
Menu price and food cost % for a dish from head chef Cristopher's verified costing rules. Send ingredient lines (qty, pack price, pack size, yield %) or a plate cost, and the menu price; get plate cost with a 3% waste and garnish allowance, food cost % ex GST, ON TARGET, WATCH or OVER TARGET against a 30% target, and the menu price that hits target, rounded up to the next 50 cents, with workings. Target, allowance and tax adjustable. Only a 200 answer is charged; refusals are free.

Use for one dish's plate cost, food cost % and the menu price that hits target. Send lines (each with qty, packPrice and packSize; unit and packUnit both or neither) or plateCost, not both. menuPrice is as shown on the menu, tax included unless pricesIncludeTax is false. Food lines only: staff, labour or money lines are a free 400. For several dishes with units sold, use calculate_menu_engineering instead. Costs $0.01. Paid automatically in USDC with x402 (test USDC when this server is set to base-sepolia), within this server's per-session and per-day spend caps. Only a 200 answer is charged; 400, 404 and 422 are free. Set dryRun to true to check for free whether this would be answered and what it costs; nothing is signed. If unsure what is covered, call check_coverage first (free). Not every answer is chef-verified: say "chef-verified by Cristopher" only when the result's label says exactly that; otherwise say it is not chef-verified. A refusal is final: don't rephrase the question to get around it.

allowancePct.description: Waste and garnish allowance. Not with plateCostIncludesAllowance true.

dryRun.description: Free quote only: check whether this would be answered and what it costs. Nothing is signed or charged.

packPrice.description: The price of one pack as bought.

qty.description: How much goes on the plate, in the pack's unit (or in `unit`).

unit.description: With packUnit, to convert; leave both out when qty and packSize are in the same unit.

yieldPct.description: The usable % of the pack after trim.

plateCost.description: A plate cost you already have.

plateCostIncludesAllowance.description: With plateCost only. True when it already has the allowance in.

roundTo.description: priceAtTarget is rounded up to the next multiple.
